title: Cloud Based Distributed Consensus (Paxos) System
achievements: Deployed a fault-tolerant distributed key-value store implementing the Paxos consensus algorithm.
Implemented election rules, sharding, and group membership management using Kubernetes StatefulSets.
Developed an Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) pipeline using Terraform and AWS CloudFormation, automating deployment and CI/CD.
Key Achievement: Achieved a 40% faster failover recovery rate compared to a local Paxos implementation.

details.headline: Implementing Paxos for Fault-Tolerant Distributed Systems
details.problem: Ensuring data consistency (consensus) and high availability in a distributed key-value store across multiple nodes prone to failure is challenging. Traditional mechanisms often suffer from slow recovery times and complex configuration management.
details.solution: Implemented the Paxos algorithm to manage replicated state across the cluster. Leveraged Kubernetes StatefulSets to provide stable network identities and persistent storage, crucial for Paxos participants (Proposers, Acceptors, Learners). Automated the entire infrastructure deployment using Terraform and AWS CloudFormation (IaC).

impact.text: Faster failover recovery rate compared to baseline
Data consistency maintained under simulated network partitions
Reduction in manual deployment time via IaC pipeline

techHighlight.title: Code Spotlight: Kubernetes StatefulSet Configuration (YAML)
techHighlight.code:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: paxos-acceptor
spec:
  serviceName: "paxos-acceptor-svc"
  replicas: 3 # Ensuring quorum (2*F + 1)
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: paxos-acceptor
  template:
    # ... (Pod specifications)
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: paxos-storage
      spec:
        accessModes: [ "ReadWriteOnce" ]
        storageClassName: "aws-ebs-gp3"
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 10Gi

points.title: StatefulSet Kind
points.description: Used instead of Deployment to guarantee the ordering and uniqueness of Pods, essential for maintaining stable identities in consensus protocols.

points.title: serviceName
points.description: Links the StatefulSet to a Headless Service, providing direct DNS resolution for peer-to-peer communication between nodes.

points.title: replicas: 3
points.description: Configured to tolerate F=1 failure (Byzantine Fault Tolerance requires 2F+1 nodes), ensuring a quorum can always be reached.

points.title: volumeClaimTemplates
points.description: Automatically provisions persistent storage (AWS EBS) for each replica, ensuring that state (like accepted proposals) survives pod restarts.
